title: cros-machine-id-regen should quote file path when computing timestamp path
description_snippet:
This is similar to another issue I reported in crosh (issue tracker here: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=957896). 

Much like the two bugs in the above issue, an unquoted variable is passed to an echo statement in ~/chromeos/src/third_party/chromiumos-overlay/chromeos-base/c
